Monetary policy decision September 2026

Published 24 September 2026

The decision in brief

The policy rate is held unchanged at 1.75 per cent.

GDP has grown faster than expected and the Swedish economy is approaching normal economic conditions.

The measured rate of inflation is low. Stronger economic activity, a weaker krona and higher energy prices mean that it is expected to rise.

Policy rate

1.75%

Applies from 30 September 2026

Decision documentation

Forecast for the policy rate

Policy rate, published on 24 September 2026

Figure: Policy rate and forecast in the short run September 2026.csv

The figure shows the outcomes for the policy rate (solid line) and the Riksbank’s forecast of the policy rate in the coming three quarters (dashed line). Outcomes are daily data and the forecast refer to quarterly average values. Read more about the forecast for the policy rate in the Monetary Policy Report . Source: The Riksbank.

Next monetary policy decision?

The next monetary policy meeting will take place on 3 November 2026 and information on the monetary policy decision, including the policy rate, will be communicated the day after, 4 November 2026 .
